title: Boss part 1: tests for clean_lines

ticket.subject: Tests for clean_lines
ticket.body: clean_lines prepares the lines of a report. Write tests for it, one test function for each rule the owner lists. The game runs your tests against the correct version and against wrong versions.

rules: A test checks that spaces are removed from both ends of each line.
A test checks that lines blank after trimming are dropped.
A test checks that the lines keep their original order.

title: Boss part 2: tests for count_words

ticket.subject: Tests for count_words
ticket.body: count_words counts the words on the report lines. Write tests for it, one test function for each rule the owner lists. The game runs your tests against the correct version and against wrong versions.

rules: A test checks that words are split on any whitespace.
A test checks that counting ignores case.
A test checks that the result is a dict from each word to its count.

title: Boss part 3: tests for top_words

ticket.subject: Tests for top_words
ticket.body: top_words picks the most common words for the report. Write tests for it, one test function for each rule the owner lists. The game runs your tests against the correct version and against wrong versions.

rules: A test checks that the highest count comes first.
A test checks that ties are ordered A to Z.
A test checks that at most n pairs are returned.

title: Boss part 4: tests for report_lines

ticket.subject: Tests for report_lines
ticket.body: report_lines writes the report lines. Write tests for it, one test function for each rule the owner lists. The game runs your tests against the correct version and against wrong versions.

rules: A test checks that each line reads "word: count".
A test checks that the order of the pairs is kept.
